maintenance_led.reason: Sells mined salt, de-icing products, sulfate of potash and magnesium chloride; consumables used up, not repair or aftermarket work.

publicly_funded.reason: Highway de-icing salt goes to governments, but the larger part is spread across consumer, agriculture, industrial and chemical buyers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows through its own mines and production sites for salt and plant nutrients; acquisitions are occasional, not a roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Salt, ice melters and magnesium chloride are largely commodity products bought on price, and buyers can change suppliers easily.

notes: Highway de-icing sales to public agencies are significant, so the public-funding answer is a judgement call.
